tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Get live dates and prices for one product (Lion King: slug the-lion-king-tickets, city london). When that product or booking calendar is on screen, the date is highlighted or selected. Does not place an order or take payment. Checkout stays a human click.

product_id.description: Stable product_id from search_events / tickadoo_search. Preferred.

slug.description: Product slug. Use with city_slug when product_id is unavailable.

city_slug.description: City slug required when slug is used.

date_from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

date_to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 14 days after date_from.

date.description: Alias for date_from when checking a single day.

tools.name: get_experience_details
tools.description: Get richer product, venue and booking fields for one experience. Pass product_id from search_events. Does not book or take payment.

slug.description: Product slug when product_id is unavailable.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search tickadoo for theatre and experiences. West End / Lion King queries update the visible search or London listing when those pages are open. Returns product_id for get_availability. Does not book or take payment.

query.description: Free-text search. West End / Lion King buyer path: 'The Lion King', 'West End tonight', 'Lion King London'.

city.description: City slug (optional), e.g. london, new-york, paris

tools.name: tickadoo_cities
tools.description: List the cities where tickadoo has bookable experiences.

tools.name: tickadoo_open_product
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to a tickadoo product, search, city listing, or booking-date page. Does not open checkout, cart, account, or payment. Checkout stays a human click.

tools.name: tickadoo_search
tools.description: Search tickadoo's catalogue of theatre, tours, attractions and experiences across 700+ cities.

query.description: Free-text search. West End / Lion King buyer path: 'The Lion King', 'West End tonight', 'Lion King London'.

city.description: City slug (optional), e.g. london, new-york, paris

tools.name: whats_on_tonight
tools.description: What is on tonight. West End / Lion King infers London. On home, search or a London city listing, opens /london/today. Confirm with get_availability. Does not book or take payment.

city.description: City slug, e.g. london. Inferred from the page, or from West End / Lion King.

query.description: Optional hint such as West End or Lion King. Used to infer London when city is omitted.

category.description: Optional category slug to narrow results.
